hotels_str = get_all_hotels_in_city("Paris")

hotel_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_hotels(hotels_list)

class HotelRating(BaseModel):
    name: str
    rating: float

hotel_ratings_structured = [
    query_ai_assistant(
        f"Extract the hotel name and its rating from this review info: {hotel}: {hotel_ratings[hotel]}. Only return the name and rating.",
        HotelRating
    )
    for hotel in hotels_list

hotel_prices = get_hotels_prices(top_rated_hotels)

# Step 6: Parse prices into a structured format
class HotelPrice(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price: float

    query_ai_assistant(
        f"Extract the hotel name and its price from this info: {hotel}: {hotel_prices[hotel]}. Only return the name and price.",
        HotelPrice
    )
    for hotel in top_rated_hotels
]

# Step 7: Choose the hotel with the highest price among the top-rated
max_price = max([h.price for h in hotel_prices_structured])

)
